title.narrative: Strengthening Health Management Information Systems, Laboratory Network and Procurement and Supply Chain Management Systems in Nigeria - Nigeria (01-Apr-2019-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Nigeria, RSSH, Management Sciences for Health (MSH)This program has the following goals: To achieve a responsive and resilient health system that promotes universal access to quality health care services by 2020. The objectives of this program are: To increase real-time data collection and transmission to the national DHIS2 instance and interoperability of existing disease programmes data platforms. To improve the quality of data reported on the DHIS2 across disease programmes using an integrated data quality assurance framework.. To attain and maintain end-to-end stock visibility through scale-up of eLMIS platform (NAVISION) to health facilities.. To promote the quality of laboratory services through the implementation of standards and procedures appropriate to the requirements at each level of healthcare delivery
